briefFull: The objective of the scheme is to encourage large cardamom farmers to adopt scientific curing methods using improved drying equipment, thereby enhancing the quality of large cardamom for domestic and export markets.
details:
Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: Post-Harvest Improvement – Large Cardamom Driers (Nos.) is implemented by the Spices Board, India under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry.
The objective of the scheme is to encourage large cardamom farmers to adopt scientific curing methods using improved drying equipment, thereby enhancing the quality of large cardamom for domestic and export markets.
The scheme is implemented in accordance with the guidelines and modalities approved by the Competent Authority under the Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom during the 15th Finance Commission period (2021–22 to 2025–26).
benefits:
- 33.33 % of cost of unit, subject to a maximum of ₹16,000/- per unit for General Category and 75% subject to maximum of ₹28,000/- per unit for NE/SC/ST & Kalimpong and Darjeeling District of West Bengal & 90% Spice Producer's Groups in Identified Clusters subjected to maximum ₹43,000/-
- Marginal Cardamom growers having 0.10 ha to 0.40 ha can avail for 200 kg capacity bhatti or single door sawo / equivalent drier Small growers having 0.4 ha to 8 ha can avail 400 kg capacity bhatti or double door sawo / equivalent drier. Quantum of assistance limited to the capacity eligible for the applicant as above.
eligibility:
1.The scheme applies to Sikkim, Darjeeling & Kalimpong district of West Bengal & other NE States
2. Designated Officials will conduct final inspection and recommend the eligible cases.
howToApply:
[Online]
**Registration**
Step 1: The applicant should visit the [ServicesPlus](https://serviceonline.gov.in/dbt/) website.
Step 2: Click on the “[Register” ](https://serviceonline.gov.in/dbt/citizenRegistration.html)option on the homepage.
Step 3: Fill out the registration form by entering Full Name, Email ID, Mobile Number, Password, selecting State, and Captcha.
Step 4: Review all details carefully and submit the registration form.
Step 5: An OTP will be sent to your registered mobile number or email; enter the OTP and click “Verify.”
Step 6: Registration will be completed successfully, and a confirmation message will be displayed or sent via email.
**Login**
Step 1: The applicant should visit the ServicesPlus website and click on [“Login.”](https://serviceonline.gov.in/dbt/loginWindow.do)
Step 2: Enter your Email ID, Password, and Captcha.
Step 3: Select the relevant service/scheme name.
Step 4: Fill in the required details in the application form.
Step 5: Submit the application.
documentsRequired:
a) Current year land tax receipt /Parcha copy /
b) Aadhar card
c) Bank Passbook First page – copy
d) No Objection Certificate from panchayats if the Land is not in the beneficiary’s name.

faqs.q: What is the objective of the Large Cardamom Driers scheme?
faqs.a: The scheme aims to encourage large cardamom farmers to adopt scientific curing methods using improved driers to enhance the quality of large cardamom.
The scheme is implemented by the Spices Board, India, under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry, Government of India.

faqs.q: Which areas are covered under the scheme?
faqs.a: The scheme is available in Sikkim, Darjeeling and Kalimpong districts of West Bengal, and other North Eastern States.

faqs.q: What type of drier is provided to marginal growers?
faqs.a: Marginal growers having 0.10 to 0.40 hectares of large cardamom cultivation are eligible for a 200 kg capacity Bhatti, Single Door Sawo, or equivalent drier.

faqs.q: What type of drier is available for small growers?
faqs.a: Small growers having more than 0.40 hectares up to 8 hectares are eligible for a 400 kg capacity Bhatti, Double Door Sawo, or equivalent drier.

faqs.q: Can a farmer receive assistance for a larger-capacity drier than their eligibility?
faqs.a: No. Financial assistance is limited to the drier capacity for which the applicant is eligible.

faqs.q: Can Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs) or groups apply?
faqs.a: Yes. Eligible groups and FPOs can apply as per the assistance norms prescribed under the scheme.
Yes. A copy of the applicant's Aadhaar Card must be submitted with the application.

faqs.q: Is inspection required before receiving assistance?
faqs.a: Yes. Designated officials conduct a final inspection and recommend eligible cases for assistance.
